verdict.rationale: Hightouch is not itself an agent product but a CDP platform, so the MCP-server axis applies; it ships a documented official MCP server that connects AI assistants to build audiences, manage syncs, design journeys, and analyze performance in natural language, with example prompts and scoped API-key auth for AI tools. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of the MCP server's reliability beyond vendor docs.
